risk_summary.quantity_basis: gross held positions; pending orders not netted

positions.thesis: Cypherpunk is primarily a leveraged Zcash-treasury position with a capital-hungry oncology option. ZEC per diluted share and liquidity must rise without destructive issuance while any sirexatamab Phase 3 path is funded outside the treasury thesis.

Waystar is a healthcare-payment software compounder: subscription growth, 108% retention, and 43% adjusted EBITDA margin must keep converting provider complexity into recurring cash flow without acquisition or leverage drag.
A development-stage bet on Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus. Commercial agreements and funded delivery—not headline capacity—must validate it.

Legacy Robinhood protein holding. The GLP-1 muscle-preservation theme does not currently provide a clean BRBR-specific public-equity expression; retain it transparently while brand-level volume, pricing, and margin evidence either creates a direct thesis or invalidates it.

AAON is a data-center cooling and custom HVAC capacity-ramp position. Record BASX demand and a $2.0 billion backlog must convert into revenue, improving gross margin, and cash generation faster than Memphis overhead, outsourcing, and working-capital needs consume the upside.

RoboStrategy is a closed-end private-robotics access position. Monthly NAV growth and portfolio-company financing or liquidity events must outrun the stock's premium to stale Level 3 marks, a 3.98% estimated expense load, dilution, and weak price discovery.

Grindr is a high-margin subscription-network position. Paying-user and ARPPU growth must sustain roughly 40% adjusted EBITDA margins while product expansion broadens monetization without weakening trust, safety, privacy, or the core community.

Nike is a brand-and-distribution turnaround position. Wholesale growth and performance-product traction must become durable revenue and margin recovery while NIKE Direct, Greater China, inventory units, and tariff exposure stop consuming the upside.

Oscar Health is an ACA individual-market scale position. Membership growth and technology-led operating leverage must preserve medical-cost discipline as enhanced subsidies expire and 2027 integrity rules test enrollment quality, pricing, and retention.
